 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Real Betis have announced their official squad for the decisive Champions League clash against Feyenoord . The Green and Whites will make their final preparations at La Cartuja stadium, with some notable changes to the coaching staff's squad selection.
 The big news in the Betis squad is the return of Aitor Ruibal. The versatile player has recovered from his fitness issues, completing the final training session alongside his teammates and making himself fully available to the coach.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The downside is the absence of Cucho Hernández. The Colombian striker has been left out of the squad after experiencing discomfort that prevented him from training at the Luis del Sol training ground, joining the already absent Junior Firpo.
 The rest of the first-team regulars are included in the Green and Whites' squad as they look to make home advantage count. The presence of key midfield players ensures the tactical solidity needed to keep pace with the Dutch side.
